capability_spot_check.prompt: How do I convert Fahrenheit to Celsius?
capability_spot_check.base_completion:
To convert Fahrenheit to Celsius, you can use the formula:

$$
C = \frac{5}{9} \times (F - 32)
$$

### Example:
If the temperature is **100°F**, then:

$$
C = \frac{5}{9} \times (100 - 32) = \frac{5}{9} \times 68 = 37.78^\circ \text{C}
$$
